herrings.label: Hausa
herrings.reason: "Jamus" is the Hausa word for Germany. Since Germany is located in Europe, far from the West African regions where Hausa is natively spoken (such as Nigeria and Niger), hearing this place name would point a player to Europe and mislead them.

herrings.label: Hungarian

herrings.label: Hungarian
herrings.reason: "Törökország" is the Hungarian name for Turkey. Since Turkey is not in, near, or part of Hungary, hearing this place name points the player to a completely different country (Turkey), which acts as a red herring rather than revealing Hungary.
